title: Execution-grant ledger record
description: One entry in the append-only grant ledger (Phase 2), mirroring sarc-suite-one-pass's governed-buffer write-history design (composition.py / the Evidence Set's remediation records): every issuance and every consumption is a new appended entry, never an in-place mutation, so replay detection (loss-model.yaml's replayed_consumed_grant) can be verified by scanning the ledger rather than trusting a single mutable flag.

grant_id.description: Opaque token identifying one consumable per-execution grant.

sealed_action_content_hash.description: sha256 of the sealed final (post-remediation) action this grant is bound to -- the single-use binding: this grant_id authorizes execution of exactly this content hash, nothing else, and exactly once (see 'event').

event.description: issued: a fresh grant was minted for a sealed action, not yet used. consumed: the grant was presented at execution time, matched an 'issued' entry with no prior 'consumed' entry for the same grant_id, and admission proceeded -- this is the one legitimate use. consumption_rejected_replay: the grant was presented again after a 'consumed' entry already existed for the same grant_id (loss-model.yaml's replayed_consumed_grant fired) -- recorded, not silently dropped, so CH-A3's replay-admission count is auditable from the ledger alone.

decision_id.description: The decision this ledger entry is about.
